definitions.explanation: A reference book or digital resource listing words and their meanings, often with translations or detailed explanations.

examples.japanese: {辞書|じしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。

⟦{和英|わえい}→和英：05253_waei⟧{辞書|じしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{翻訳|ほんやく}→翻訳：01725_honyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{辞書|じしょ} is a compound: ⟦{辞|じ}→辞：noentry⟧ (words) + ⟦{書|しょ}→書：noentry⟧ (book).

TYPES OF {辞書|じしょ}:
- ⟦{国語|こくご}→国語：02739_kokugo⟧{辞書|じしょ}/⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ (Japanese dictionary)
- ⟦{英和|えいわ}→英和：04018_eiwa⟧{辞書|じしょ} (English-Japanese)

{辞書|じしょ} and ⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ are often interchangeable, though ⟦{辞典|じてん}→辞典：01640_jiten⟧ can feel slightly more formal or comprehensive (like an encyclopedia).
